resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 613 ft (187 m) and the Tennessee list gives 617 ft for the site; the difference is about 4 ft, and both figures are reported

notes_for_editor: Two sources agree the tower exists, is in Henry County, is administered by the Tennessee Division of Forestry and is listed as standing. Nothing found on construction date, staffing, fires or fate; two WebSearch queries and a check of the statewide NRHP MPS listing and Paris Wikipedia page turned up nothing about this tower. Access level set to 'unknown': 'restricted' had been inferred from 'located at an active TN Forestry site', and no visiting rules were found.
